verdict.rationale: ROCm, the card's own software stack, documents scriptable, display-free ways to run workloads. These include passing GPU device nodes to Docker containers with `--device` for reproducible environments, prebuilt Docker images for vLLM and SGLang, use-case-driven package selection, and an offline runfile installer on Linux. Nothing explicitly documents headless or CI operation of the RX 9070 XT, so automation fit is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: explicit headless/no-display operation docs for Radeon, CI-runner integration guidance, hands-on or independent corroboration of the 9070 XT running in CI.
